sense: to hold someone close in your arms

pins.definition: To hold someone close in your arms to show affection.
To put your arms around someone to show affection or greet them.
To put your arms around someone and hold them close, especially to show affection.

situation: A grandfather and his adult granddaughter embrace tightly after reuniting at a train station platform.
subject: the tight embrace holding someone close
brief: An elderly man in a tweed jacket and a young woman wrap their arms completely around each other in a tight, full-bodied embrace on a sunlit station platform. Their eyes are closed, heads pressed together, and his jacket creases deeply where her hands clasp his back, fully demonstrating the closeness of the hold.
